verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at docs.incident.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200). It links a markdown export of the 456-page help center, so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-readable docs. A downloadable OpenAPI 3.0 spec is also offered. Missing for 10: the llms.txt is a sparse single-entry index with no per-section structure or llms-full.txt variant evidenced, and there is no first-party documentation describing the agent-oriented docs offering.
